2610.08258.title: zkLLMPoT: Efficient Zero Knowledge Proof of Training for Large Language Models
2610.08258.paper_summary: Auditing the claimed outcomes of large language model (LLM) training is challenging when model weights and training data are private, while cryptographically proving the full training process is prohibitively expensive at Transformer scale. We present zkLLMPoT, a zero-knowledge framework that certifies auditor-defined properties of a trained checkpoint through forward evaluation rather than verification of its optimization trajectory. zkLLMPoT includes 2 phases: 1) The trainer fixes the architecture and the model weights are committed. Then the auditor selects challenge sequences, preventing the trainer from modifying the checkpoint in response to the audit data. 2) Then the trainer proves the objective value attained by the committed model on those sequences. This formulation makes the certification cost independent of the number of training iterations, without revealing model weights or requiring access to private training data. We build on sumcheck- and lookup-based arguments to certify Transformer computations, while supporting next-token loss and task-specific audit objectives. Across four model families, operator-level benchmarks yield proving times of 41-59 seconds for 1.1-1.5B-parameter models and 131 seconds at 13B for the covered operators, with verification below half a second at a sequence length of 512.
2610.08258.paper_summary_zh: 審計大型語言模型（LLM）訓練所聲稱的結果是具有挑戰性的，因為模型權重和訓練數據是私有的，而在Transformer規模下，對整個訓練過程進行加密證明的成本是過於昂貴的。我們提出了 zkLLMPoT，一個零知識框架，通過前向評估而非驗證其優化軌跡來證明審計員定義的訓練檢查點屬性。zkLLMPoT 包含兩個階段：1）訓練者固定架構並提交模型權重。然後，審計員選擇挑戰序列，防止訓練者根據審計數據修改檢查點。2）然後，訓練者證明提交的模型在這些序列上達到的目標值。這種表述使得認證成本與訓練迭代次數無關，且不揭示模型權重或要求訪問私有訓練數據。我們基於 sumcheck 和 lookup 的論證來證明Transformer計算，同時支持下一個標記損失和特定任務的審計目標。在四個模型系列中，運算符級基準測試對於 1.1-1.5B 參數模型的證明時間為 41-59 秒，對於涵蓋的運算符在 13B 時為 131 秒，驗證時間在序列長度為 512 時低於半秒。
